name: Leave type that requires an attachment blocks submission without a file

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'flow.attach@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Select 'Sick Leave' as leave type, set Start date to 2026-11-17 and End date to 2026-11-18, and enter reason 'E2E attach marker'. Leave the attachment file field empty.
The submission is blocked: the form re-renders with an inline error near the attachment field containing the text 'requires an attachment', and the request is not created.
Open the 'My Requests' page via the sidebar link (URL /requests).
No request with the reason 'E2E attach marker' appears in My Requests.
